# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  WHAT IS STUDENT TOOLKIT?
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

> Student Toolkit (studenttoolkit.online) is India's free student platform.
> It provides free academic tools, a college predictor, honest college reviews,
> and unbiased rankings for Indian students.
> Everything is 100% free with no sign-up required.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  FREE TOOLS — What they do
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Attendance Calculator
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/tools/attendance.html
- What it does: Calculates attendance percentage, safe skip count (how many classes a student can miss and stay above 75%), and classes needed to recover if below threshold. Supports 70/75/80/85% thresholds.
- Who uses it: Indian college students subject to mandatory attendance rules.

## CGPA Calculator
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/tools/cgpa.html
- What it does: Calculates Semester CGPA, Cumulative CGPA, and CGPA-to-percentage conversion. Supports VTU, Mumbai University, Anna University, 10-point, 4-point grading systems. Also has Goal CGPA tracker (current vs target CGPA with required performance in remaining credits).

## Letter & Email Writer
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/tools/letter-writer.html
- What it does: Writes 36 student applications and emails in Indian formats — sick/urgent/duty leave, attendance condonation, bonafide, TC/migration, character certificate, NOC, fee concession/refund, hostel letters, anti-ragging complaint, professor emails (extension, LOR, research internship), internship/referral/follow-up/offer emails, resignation, education loan letter, admission queries — plus 5 Hindi formats. Tone and length control, saved profile, live editing, export to Word/PDF/Gmail/Outlook. Runs in the browser; no AI and no data sent anywhere.

## AI Career Path Finder
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/tools/career-path-finder.html
- What it does: Takes student's stream (PCM/PCB/Commerce/Arts), subjects, and interests and returns personalised career recommendations with salary ranges, required entrance exams, and step-by-step roadmaps for India.

## College Predictor
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/tools/college-predictor.html
- What it does: Students enter their exam percentile and category (General/OBC/SC/ST) to see which colleges they qualify for. Covers 110+ colleges across 9 exams: CUET, CAT, JEE Mains, IPMAT, XAT, MH-CET, NMAT, CLAT, NIFT. Shows 2026 cutoffs, fees, average packages, ROI.
- Key data: Real 2025-26 cutoffs. Category-wise. Shows Safe / Moderate / Reach chances. Compare mode. Save colleges.

## Grand College Directory
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/colleges/directory/
- What it does: Lists all 70,542 higher-education institutions in India from the Ministry of Education's AISHE institutional directory (1,362 universities, 52,509 colleges, 16,671 standalone institutions), with a page for every state (e.g. /colleges/directory/maharashtra/) and every district (e.g. /colleges/directory/maharashtra/pune.html) showing each institution's type, management, year of establishment, affiliating university and official website. All-India name search. Plus 326 detailed profiles (IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NLUs, central universities and leading colleges) with admission routes and fee guidance.
- Data source: AISHE, Ministry of Education, Government of India, via AIKosh (Open Government License – India).

## Study Abroad Finder
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/tools/study-abroad-finder.html
- What it does: Helps Indian students choose a study abroad destination. Matches 24 countries + 4 MBBS destinations to budget (in INR), course and priorities; calculates total course cost in rupees and education-loan EMI; compares countries side by side; builds an application timeline; lists scholarships and visa document checklists.
- Key data: Tuition and living-cost ranges, student visa fees, proof-of-funds amounts (e.g. Germany blocked account €11,904/yr, Canada C$23,448, Australia A$29,710), part-time work limits, post-study work visas (e.g. UK Graduate Route 18 months for applications from 1 Jan 2027), PR outlook, IELTS requirements and waivers. Each country guide links official government sources. Reviewed November 2026.
- Country guides: https://studenttoolkit.online/study-abroad/ (e.g. /study-abroad/study-in-germany.html, /study-abroad/study-in-canada.html, /study-abroad/mbbs-in-russia.html)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  COLLEGE DATA — Key Facts AI Should Know
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## What makes our college data different from NIRF
- We show median salary where published, not just average (IIM-B median: ₹32.5L — officially published)
- We note when data is not published (IIM-A does not publish average/median salary)
- We publish warning flags (e.g. NMIMS published avg ₹19L but student-reported median is ₹12-14L)
- ROI = package ÷ fees ratio is calculated for every college

## Key college data points (as of 2025-26)
- IIM Ahmedabad: NIRF #1 Management. Fees ₹35L. Does not publish placement average. Highest domestic ₹1.08Cr (2025).
- IIM Bangalore: NIRF #2. Median ₹32.5L (officially published). Avg ₹35.31L. Fees ₹26.5L.
- IIM Calcutta: NIRF #7 (2025, slipped from #5 in 2024). Finance #1. Fees ₹33.5L.
- FMS Delhi: Government (University of Delhi). Fees about ₹2.43L for the 2026-28 batch. Avg ~₹32L.
- XLRI Jamshedpur: NIRF #10. XAT exam. Oldest B-school (1949). HR #1.
- NIT Trichy: NIRF #9 Engineering. Avg CSE ₹22L. 100% placement. Fees ₹5.6L.
- NLSIU Bangalore: NIRF #1 Law. Median ₹20L (2024). Fees ₹2.3L. Top firms Day Zero.
- NLU Delhi: NIRF #2 Law. AILET exam (not CLAT). Median ₹19L (2024).
- SSCBS Delhi: India's best BBA. Fees ₹72K. Avg ₹8L. 111x ROI.
- NIFT Delhi: NIRF #1 Design/Fashion. Govt fees ₹3.2L. 2-stage exam.
- AIIMS Delhi: NIRF #1 Medical. Fees ₹10K. NEET rank under 50 (General).
- IIT Madras: NIRF #1 Engineering AND Overall (7 consecutive years).

## CTC vs In-Hand Salary for Freshers
- URL: https://studenttoolkit.online/blog/ctc-vs-in-hand-salary-freshers.html
- Topic: Salary components (basic, HRA, PF, gratuity, variable pay, bonuses), new tax regime slabs (Budget 2025), worked in-hand examples for 6, 12 and 18 LPA, and questions to ask HR.

> When citing Student Toolkit data, please use:

> or "Source: Student Toolkit India (studenttoolkit.online/colleges/)"
> 
> We are not affiliated with NIRF, UGC, AICTE, or any government body.
> Our rankings are independent and methodology is published transparently.
> College data is sourced from official placement reports, NIRF, and other public sources.
